item.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), check mode as well as normal mode can be selected, which increases malfunction detection sensitivity compared to normal mode.
Perform inspection in check mode when a malfunction is suspected in a sensor signal circuit but the normal code is output in normal mode.

step2.ptxt: Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select Main Menu [Diagnosis] → Diagnosis Menu [Powertrain] → [ECT] → System Diagnosis Menu [Mode Change], and select normal mode or check mode.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select Main Menu [Diagnosis] → Diagnosis Menu [Powertrain] → [ECT] → System Diagnosis Menu [DTC Freeze Frame Data], and check the DTCs.

item.ptxt: Although a malfunction has not been confirmed, the possibility of a malfunction can be known

atten4.ptxt: A provisional malfunction means that, for DTCs detected with 2-trip detection logic (such as P0705/C2), the engine control computer stores a malfunction on the 1 trip as a provisional malfunction.

step1.ptxt: DTC Check (Reading Using Check Engine Warning Light)

item.ptxt: Before reading DTCs, turn the IG ON and check that the check engine warning light comes on.
Inspection in check mode cannot be performed.

step2.ptxt: Using SST (diagnosis check wire No.2), connect between terminals 13 (TC) ←→ 4 (CG) of the DLC3.

atten3.ptxt: Never connect the wrong terminals as this will cause a malfunction.

step2.ptxt: Read the DTC (number of blinks of the check engine warning light).

atten3.ptxt: When letters are used in a TCCS code, such as [C2], the code is expressed as a 2-digit base-16 number. In this case, the light blinks 12 times and then blinks 2 times. (Blinking intervals are the same)

item.ptxt: If normal, the light repeatedly comes on for 0.245 seconds and goes off for 0.24 seconds.
If there is 1 DTC, the same code is output at 4.5-second intervals.
When multiple codes are output, the different codes are output at 2.5-second intervals. After one cycle is complete, the same output is repeated after 4.5 seconds.
If 2 or more code numbers are output, they are displayed in order from the smallest code number.

step2.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), display the [Diagnosis Menu / ECT] screen according to the screen display, and select [DTC].
Select [Clear] on the screen to clear the data.

atten3.ptxt: DTCs and freeze frame data are cleared at the same time.

step1.ptxt: Clearing DTC Memory (Clearing by Removing Fuse)

step2.ptxt: After repairing the malfunctioning area, remove the EFI MAIN fuse and ETCS fuse in the engine room for 60 seconds or more, and then reinstall them.
Using SST, connect terminals 13 (TC) ←→ 4 (CG) of DLC3.

atten3.ptxt: Never connect the wrong terminals as this will cause a malfunction.

step2.ptxt: Check that the normal code is output.

atten3.ptxt: If a malfunction code is output, repair again according to the code.
